answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The trellis lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the vine is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors, idle agents bleed standing.
